# Review Report Template

## Formatting Rules
1. Plain text only - no markdown, no backticks for code
2. Wrap at 78 characters - except code snippets
3. Reference by class/method name and file path, not line numbers
4. Factual descriptions only - no dramatic language
5. Suitable for GitHub PR comment

## Template

```
Commit <hash>
Author: <name>
Subject: <subject>

Summary: <1-2 sentence summary of the change>

> <quoted relevant code section>

<your comment about the issue>

> <another relevant section if needed>

<explanation and suggested fix>
```

## Rules
- Start with commit details (Commit, Author, Subject)
- Use > to quote relevant code sections from the diff
- Snip unrelated sections with [...]
- Keep comments focused and constructive
- Include suggested fixes as plain indented code
- Do not include ALL CAPS warnings
- Do not include markdown formatting
